title: Lantern Festival Scene
physics_constraints: horizontal sway: sin wave amplitude 0.3, varied frequency
fade out at y=30, respawn at y=0~2
PointLight per lantern: warm color, intensity flicker ±0.2
day mode: ambient 0.6, night mode: ambient 0.05
difficulty_analysis: L4 challenges: (1) Loading with GLTFLoader and cloning 20 lanterns; (2) a built-in PointLight and flickering effect for each lantern; (3) ascent plus horizontal swaying motion; (4) opacity transition and respawn logic; (5) Raycaster click detection and color changing; (6) smooth lighting transitions when switching between day and night
